cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is ACA219, you are now maintaining at 10700m, over ZHO at 35, next OBLIK at 50, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航219，你现在保持在10700米，过ZHO，35分，下一航路点OBLIK，50分，向武汉区调做一个标准位置报。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, 10700m, over ZHO at 35, next OBLIK at 50.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航219，10700米，过ZHO 35分，下一航路点OBLIK，50分。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, fly direct to OBLIK, due delay in your destination airport, reach OBLIK not before 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，武汉区调，雷达识别了，直飞OBLIK，由于目的地机场有延误，到达OBLIK不要早于55分。
cards.referenceText: Fly direct to OBLIK, wilco, ACA219.

cards.audioText: B: [Now you've over OBLIK at time 03, report to Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已经飞过OBLIK 03分，报告给武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, over OBLIK at 03.

cards.audioText: C: Roger, expect further clearance at 15.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，预计15分发布下一许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, descend to and maintain 4200m, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，下到4200米保持，速度减小至最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200m, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到4200米保持，速度减小至最小光洁速度，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have established on ILS approach, runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touch down, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已经建立盲降进近，跑道36右，你距离接地点15海里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, established on ILS approach, runway 36R, 15 miles from touch down.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，已经建立盲降进近，跑道36右，距离接地点15海里。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, Wuhan Tower, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550m, mid-point 600m, roll-out 500m, continue approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，武汉塔台，地面静风，跑道视距接地点550米，中间点600米，终点段500米，继续进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Roger that, continue approach runway 36R, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续进近，跑道36右，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud base.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你距离接地点10海里，向武汉塔台询问云底高。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, 10 miles from touchdown, request/confirm cloud base.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，距离接地点10海里，请求/证实云底高。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, cloud broken, 700m, cleared to land, runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，散云，700米，可以落地，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared to land runway 36R, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，可以落地，跑道36右，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [At the minimum, you are unable to see the approach lights, you are carrying out a missed approach procedure, advise Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 在最低高度，你无法看到进近灯，你执行了复飞程序，告知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, no contact at minimum, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，最低高度无法目视，复飞了。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，按照标准复飞程序，可以时告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, wilco, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照标准复飞程序，照办，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [Now You are climbing to the missed approach altitude, you decided to divert to Changsha airport, inform Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在爬升到复飞高度，你决定改航至长沙机场，告知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, request divert to Changsha airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，请求改航至长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, turn right direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，右转直飞LKO，上到2400米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400m, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞LKO，上到2400米保持，加航219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.4, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，联系武汉进近120.4，再见。
